problem: PR-003 must make implementer handoff evidence machine-checkable and reviewable: before this PR there was no task/receipt schema, no bounded handoff validator, no focused test for it, no PR body template, and the root test chain did not discover tests/research-program/.
resulting_behavior: docs/research-program/handoffs/ now carries draft-2020-12 task and handoff/receipt schemas and the first conforming PR-003 handoff. scripts/research-program/check-handoff.mjs validates one handoff packet for path containment, file existence, SHA-256 and byte binding, dependency/base SHA matching against the committed execution ledger, local Git commit/ancestry, and command/artifact cross-references; it never converts a claimed success without a command result, a missing artifact or a stale dependency SHA into a pass. tests/research-program/handoff.test.mjs exercises that validator (9 tests). .github/pull_request_template.md now carries the required PR body fields, exact base/head/dependency SHA fields, sanitized handoff/evidence links and the draft-PR lifecycle. package.json registers test:research-program as `node --test tests/research-program/*.test.mjs` and chains it into the root test script after test:worker, so the previously undiscovered suite now runs under npm test. No production, corpus, schema-runtime or deployment behavior changes; typed failed/blocked/unavailable/unresolved outcomes are preserved.
